description: SP ENW - Capacity - BSP Heatmap is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - Capacity - Bulk Supply Point (BSP) Heatmap Dataset depicting all Bulk Supply Points represented as interlocking Voronoi polygons, The information contained in the dataset will enable developers to assess the level of capacity that might be available for new connections to our network. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Capacity Data. Its keywords are BSP, Capacity, Heatmap, Bulk, Supply, Point. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
